description: Wreckage of the Fuerza Aérea Salvadoreña UH-1H in which Colonel Domingo Monterrosa Barrios; commander of the Atlácatl battalion; was killed on 23 October 1984 near Joateca; Morazán; together with other senior officers. The FMLN destroyed the helicopter with a bomb concealed inside a captured Radio Venceremos transmitter that the army had loaded aboard as a trophy. Recovered wreckage is displayed at the museum as the centrepiece of its account of the war. Tail number deliberately blank: no source I could confirm gives the airframe's serial or construction number; and the variant UH-1H is taken from the English-language account of the shoot-down rather than from an inspection of the wreck; so it should be verified before publication. Recorded as an aircraft because the wreckage is deliberately retained and publicly interpreted; not abandoned in situ.
